description: Policy-capped SOL vault for an autonomous AI agent on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). create_vault, deposit, agent_withdraw, emergency_stop and drain_vault were verified, and the per-transaction cap, daily cap, cooldown, wrong-agent and stopped-vault guards all rejected.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of francis-codex/seedless-agent-wallet. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/seedless-agent-wallet. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (vault policy, agent_withdraw guards, kill switch)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/seedless-agent-wallet/
QA: devnet proof of capped agent spending
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a destination allow-list to agent_withdraw
